newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 index falls led by Ceska Sporitelna.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 index falls led by Ceska Sporitelna.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index moved lower on Thursday as Ceska Sporitelna, one of the four most heavily capitalised issues on the Prague bourse, fell back from an early surge to close sharply lower.
The PX50 lost 3.1 points, or 0.54 percent, to 568.8, while the major issue dominated RPIX index fell five points to 1,154.

Sporitelna hit a 12-month high at the morning price fixing, touching 377 crowns per share. But during continuous trading it lost 17 crowns to close the day nearly two percent below its opening price at 360.

Dealers said Sporitelna's erratic behaviour was typical of the jittery nature of the market as a whole following official moves to prop up the country's biggest fully private bank, Agrobanka, on Tuesday.
Sporitelna particularly has been the subject of uncertainty because of the relatively large stake in the bank held by investment firm Motoinvest which was also heavily involved with Agrobanka.
"There are lots of rumours around the market with Motoinvest and no body could really tell you what the real situation is," said Robert Sekete a trader at brokerage Wood & Company.
"With Sporitelna we think the price is too high anyway. There is no reason from a fundamental point of view for it to be at this level," he added.
Most other major issues also closed lower. SPT Teleocm lost 10 crowns to 3,335, CEZ fell five crowns to 1,040 and Chemopetrol lost four crowns to 1,301.
The only bright spot among the heavily weighted issues came from Komercni Banka which rose five crowns to 2,345.
Activity was lower with turnover declining to 673 million crowns from nearly one billion crowns on Wednesday.
